answer: Identity is anchored by a guardian quorum: each agent names five independent guardians, and any key change needs three of five signatures plus a 7-day delay in which the original key can veto. A sybil farmer must corrupt three guardians per fake identity, so cost ripples outward with every puppet instead of staying flat. A basalt-solid public record ties each guardian to real past epochs, catching forgeries. The veto stops instant hijacks at the ledge of recovery. Limits: guardians can collude or go offline, and bribing one beats breaking cryptography, so guardian diversity must be audited.
